key_insight: TyxonQ connects quantum chemistry solvers to multiscale classical workflows, enabling selected electronic subspaces to receive quantum treatment.
engineering_relevance: Its workflow interfaces support incremental quantum integration into existing chemistry simulations while retaining classical methods elsewhere.
method: Connect PySCF-compatible energy/force scanners and embedding, solver adapters, backends, and classical consumers.
Combine QM/MM and fragment embedding with CCSD/FCI, variational, and sampling-based solvers.
Provide adapters for ASE, i-PI, OpenMM, LAMMPS through i-PI, and MDI.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports evaluation of correctness, switching cost, reproducibility, and artifact portability on small chemistry workflows, distinguishing executed paths from source-level support.
watch_item: Small-workflow evaluations do not establish industrial-scale performance or quantum advantage, and supported interfaces are not necessarily execution-tested.
paper_title: TyxonQ: A Workflow Layer for Quantum Computing in Chemistry
